title: AI Build vs. Buy: The Question Most CX Leaders Are Missing
summary: Building or buying AI is getting easier. Operating it is harder. See how CX leaders turn AI investment into measurable results. Read the white paper.
body_markdown:
Building or buying AI is getting easier. The harder question is whether you can operate it for the long term. Explore how CX leaders can turn AI investment into measurable improvements through smarter training, quality assurance, workforce adoption and continuous optimization.
